# Accessibility Standards Canada

> > Official resource for Canadian accessibility standards including CAN-ASC-21 (Outdoor Spaces), CAN-ASC-28 (Accessible-Ready Housing), and CAN/ASC-EN 301 549:2024 (ICT Accessibility), developed under the Accessible Canada Act.

Accessibility Standards Canada develops and publishes voluntary accessibility standards, technical guides, and implementation guidance to support barrier removal across federally regulated sectors. The site provides comprehensive documentation on accessibility requirements for outdoor spaces, housing, ICT products, travel, and program/service delivery, aligned with WCAG standards and the UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities (CRPD).

## Key Topics

- Accessible Canada Act
- CAN-ASC-21 (Outdoor Spaces)
- CAN-ASC-28 (Accessible-Ready Housing)
- CAN/ASC-EN 301 549:2024 (ICT Accessibility)
- WCAG 2.0/2.1 (Web Content Accessibility Guidelines)
- Barrier removal and disability inclusion
- Accessible travel journey
- Customer service accessibility
- Program and service delivery design
- Emergency egress standards
- UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities (CRPD)
- CSA/ASC B651
- Equity-based standards
- Voluntary accessibility guidance

## Accessibility Standards (CAN-ASC Series)

- [CAN-ASC-21: Site Planning for Outdoor Spaces](https://accessible.canada.ca/creating-accessibility-standards/can-asc-21-outdoor-spaces-draft/5-site-planning): Site planning requirements for accessible outdoor spaces
- [CAN-ASC-21: Common Accessibility Measures (Clause 6)](https://accessible.canada.ca/creating-accessibility-standards/can-asc-21-outdoor-spaces-draft/6-common-accessibility-measures): Common accessibility measures for outdoor spaces design
- [CAN-ASC-21: Definitions](https://accessible.canada.ca/creating-accessibility-standards/can-asc-21-outdoor-spaces-draft/4-definitions): Terminology and definitions for outdoor spaces accessibility
- [CAN-ASC-28: Accessible-Ready Housing Scope](https://accessible.canada.ca/creating-accessibility-standards/can-asc-282025-accessible-ready-housing/7-scope): Scope and application of accessible-ready housing standards
- [CAN/ASC-EN 301 549:2024 - Web Accessibility Requirements](https://accessible.canada.ca/creating-accessibility-standards/canasc-en-301-5492024-accessibility-requirements-ict-products-and-services/9-web): Web accessibility requirements for ICT products referencing WCAG 2.0/2.1

## Technical Guides and Implementation

- [Design and Delivery of Accessible Programs and Services](https://accessible.canada.ca/creating-accessibility-standards/design-and-delivery-accessible-programs-and-services-including-customer-services): Comprehensive guide on accessible program design and customer service delivery
- [Understanding Impact of Accessibility Measures](https://accessible.canada.ca/creating-accessibility-standards/design-and-delivery-accessible-programs-and-services-including-customer-services/4-guidance-understanding-impact): Guidance on assessing impact of accessible program and service delivery
- [About the Accessible Travel Journey Technical Guide](https://accessible.canada.ca/creating-accessibility-standards/technical-guide-accessible-travel-journey/2-about-technical-guide): Introduction to technical guidance on accessible travel
- [Passenger Considerations for Accessible Travel](https://accessible.canada.ca/creating-accessibility-standards/technical-guide-accessible-travel-journey/11-passenger-considerations): Guidance on passenger assistance and accommodations during travel

## Optional Resources

- [CAN-ASC-22 Legal Notice](https://accessible.canada.ca/creating-accessibility-standards/can-asc-22-emergency-egress-exit/3-asc-legal-notice): Legal disclaimer for Emergency Egress Exit draft standard
